spatialLayout.worldAnchor: Captured once after tracking starts; Recall explicitly repositions it.
spatialLayout.overview: 5 cm per metre, courtyard 60 by 40 cm, drafting tilt 50 degrees. Model centre at captured camera plus (0,8,-195) cm after yaw rotation.
spatialLayout.panels: Planner and details at camera-yaw offsets (-44,4,-200) and (44,4,-200) cm; each 26 cm wide. Timeline at (0,-28,-200) cm, 60 cm wide. SIK indirect selection supported.
spatialLayout.handles: Independent authored siblings of the tilted model, unit scale, world-identity rotation; their world positions use the same ENU adapter.
spatialLayout.fullscale: 100 cm per metre, unchanged exact geometry; fixed 1.65 metre eye-height observations at ENU (2.5,2), (2.5,-2), (9.5,2). Inspection panel at captured camera-yaw offset (-25,-2,-150) cm.
spatialLayout.annotations: Spatial text faces the captured yaw, including after Recall; 3x annotation size in fullscale. Controls retain centimetre dimensions.
